relationships.subject: eptinezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: This study evaluates the efficacy of the intravenous CGRP mAb eptinezumab in these therapy-refractory patients.

key_findings: In 41 migraine patients refractory to subcutaneous CGRP(-R) mAbs, eptinezumab gave a >=30% reduction in monthly migraine days in 23.1% at week 12 and 29.7% at week 24
Monthly migraine days fell from 16.3 to 14.4 (p=0.07); no adverse events
